vsrestraints:request-question:
{0} wants to apply: {1}.
Accepting restricts the corresponding actions. Closing this dialog or letting it expire declines the request.
vsrestraints:request-busy: That player already has a pending restraint request. Please try again later.
vsrestraints:pillory-entered: Your neck and hands are now held in the pillory. Another player must close it. Right-click again to leave while open; you cannot release yourself once closed.
vsrestraints:pillory-status-open: Open: sneak-right-click to enter; right-click to close the empty pillory.
vsrestraints:pillory-status-fallen: Toppled: right-click to stand upright. Sprinting into or striking an unreinforced pillory with a melee weapon can knock it over.
vsrestraints:pillory-cannot-stand: Cannot stand upright: solid ground and room for the post and stocks are required. Move away if you are blocking it.
vsrestraints:pillory-entry-blocked: Cannot enter the pillory: blocks obstruct the standing position.
vsrestraints:pillory-displaced: The pillory toppled or started falling. You have been released.
vsrestraints:pillory-hit-reinforced: Hit: vanilla reinforcement protects this pillory from knockdown.
vsrestraints:pillory-hit-blocked: Hit, but there is not enough room to fall or the surrounding land is protected.
vsrestraints:pillory-status-closed: Closed: another authorized player can right-click to open it.
vsrestraints:pillory-status-waiting: {0} has entered. Another player can right-click to close it.
vsrestraints:request-expired: The request expired or its conditions changed.
chain-needs-restraint: The target must wear handcuffs or leg shackles first.
chain-already-bound: The target already has a chain attached.
chain-too-short: The chain is too short, or the endpoints are in different dimensions. Move closer or join a longer chain first.
chain-first-connected: First end connected. Right-click the other end, or click the first end again to cancel.
chain-end-missing: The first endpoint is no longer available. Chain disconnected.
chain-connected: Both ends connected. Sneak-right-click either endpoint with an empty hand to recover the chain.
chain-legacy: Split off one chain, or hold a hammer in your off hand and right-click to join the stack into one longer chain before tethering.
chain-pending: First end connected: right-click the other end to finish. Click the first end again or sneak-right-click air to cancel.
chain-cannot-merge: No chains available to join, or this chain is bound / already 64 blocks long. Length: {0} blocks.
